text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Not too long ago, in a certain town, there lived a completely ordinary Umamusume named Machitan.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Machitan worked diligently as the face of her family's very popular restaurant and was well-loved by all the customers!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sharing meals with everyone put a smile on her face!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Wait, that's not it. Seeing everyone's happy faces as they ate their meals is what put a smile on her face!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: These happy days continued on… until an Umamusume race started playing on the restaurant's TV!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: As the customers watched the race, their smiles grew larger and larger! Machitan was no exception—her heart started lubbing and dubbing like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And that was that! In an instant, Machitan fell in love with the world of racing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: She joined a club and began training. Then she signed up for a tryout, and once she passed…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: She was accepted to Tracen Academy! Where she lived happily ever after!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's it?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yep, that's it! Pretty typical, huh? Even the way I got interested in racing was really ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The fact you were able to get into Tracen at all makes it difficult to consider you particularly ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No kidding. This is one of the hardest schools to get into in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is a day to remember—the day that Matikanetannhauser and I begin our foray into the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've come to watch a scrimmage with some of her friends…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The wild and energetic Twin Turbo, the slightly cynical Nice Nature, and the highly intelligent Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So it's finally time for your debut race, Machi.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahem. Excuse me, Ms. Matikanetannhauser! Could you tell us about your goals as you embark on the Twinkle Series?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Great question, Nature! I simply want to do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I mean the races in the Twinkle Series are packed with really strong runners.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's perfectly normal to not win graded races, and only a small handful are able to win G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But some strive for even greater feats, like becoming the Classic Triple Crown champion or conquering the Twin Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Winning even a single G1 race is already a tall order, yet they have to win several in a row!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You really have to wonder how they achieve such glory.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I totally get what you mean!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But you know, that feeling's exactly what makes me want to win.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You want to… win? I mean, I understand the feeling. I get it, but…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm going where the competition is. I want to go out there and win, nice and normal-like!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So to start off, I've decided to never give up and aim for first place in every race!

text_block_list.name: Nature & Turbo
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I like the sound of that! Count me in!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You too?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hang on! How did you reach that conclusion from everything you said before?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Look! I've even planned out my whole strategy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser pulls out a notebook and shows it to Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wow, you weren't lying! Even your meals are planned out.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pretty good, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Geez. As always, I don't know if you just like to dream big or if you just don't know any better…

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Now, now, I'd say that's one of her better qualities.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Not just anyone has the ability to chase after big dreams like it's perfectly normal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, a huge cheer erupts from the stands, as if to cut their conversation short.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: It's started! The race between Teio and McQueen has started!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Everyone is at their starting gate… and the race has begun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wow! Teio and McQueen have burst to the front by themselves! They're crazy fast!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That's why all the stayers look up to McQueen! Her very presence is on another level!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: You can really see why people are calling Teio the star of the classic year. She really is a prodigy!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It's clear that the two of them are a cut above the rest.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: They've passed the 200-meter mark and are far ahead of the other racers! It's basically a one-on-one duel!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: This is where the real race begins! Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Not on my watch! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What an absolutely, positively incredible race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: …Though, to be honest, it makes me glad that I didn't bother entering.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: The other racers sure look grim. It's understandable, though, considering how soundly they were beaten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems the cheers for the two prodigies were loud enough to sting the hearts of the "ordinary" Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wow! What an incredible race! Don't you think so?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It really was unbelievable. A duel between two phenomenal talents…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's like the other racers weren't even there! Gosh! They were so incredible it gave me tingles!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I wonder… What would it take for an ordinary runner like me to beat them? Maybe a direct pursuit from the rear?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But Teio's acceleration is tremendous, so I'd need to conserve enough stamina to deal with that…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I guess I should start by building up some muscle.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …We just witnessed a sight that strikes fear into the heart of most runners, or leaves them dumbstruck or discouraged at the very least…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's not really something that gets people excited.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: O-oh. Really?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, really. Though… I could probably stand to learn a thing or two from you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Anyway… I'm going back to campus.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Nature! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, did I say something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: On the contrary! Nice Nature's observation is exceedingly apt! It's one of your greatest charms!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Director!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I happened to overhear you while I was taking a stroll. Pure coincidence! Setting that aside…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: You should know that I'm expecting great things from you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Y-y-y-you are?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's because you're you that you have the potential to guide many other Umamusume! I implore you to give your races everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …And that's what she said! Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This isn't the first time that Director Akikawa has said something like that to Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: You have a bright future! I'm very much looking forward to watching your races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wonder if she was speaking as the director of the academy or as an individual who cares for Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her true intentions remain unclear, but there's no doubt she has her eye on Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I really don't know why she has any kind of hopes for me…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh well, I'll think about it later! The fact that she knew about my debut means she must be keeping track of my progress!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm just happy to know she's taken notice of me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right! That settles it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'll give the Twinkle Series a go!
choice_data_list: (So… not going all out I guess.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You too, Trainer! Let's both put in a little effort!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ignoring the "a little effort" part, it does seem that Director Akikawa's expectations have made a big impression on Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, my days pursuing victory with the ordinary, slightly clumsy, yet hardworking Matikanetannhauser begin.
